1. The whole issue of BL contributions for self-employed individuals on B1 is extremely unclear. In general, employed B1 visa holders are insured by BL for a very limited number of insurance branches, so under the same logic, also self employed people should be insured for the same branches and pay contributions accordingly. 
Your accountant is right that you CAN pay BL contributions (and get allowances, if you'll be eligible), this is done by issuing a fake ID number for BL. 

2. I think you should create a different post for this question, there are many people in this group who have gone through this and I'm sure will be able to share. In general, employed B1 visa holders are entitled for hospitalization cost coverage because this is one of the insurance branches that B1 holders are insured for. If the mom is not working, or not insured for another reason, then it can go through the dad.
You can some information here: https://www.kolzchut.org.il/he/%D7%9B%D7%99%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%99_%D7%94%D7%95%D7%A6%D7%90%D7%95%D7%AA_%D7%90%D7%A9%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%96_%D7%9C%D7%A6%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%9A_%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%93%D7%94_%D7%A9%D7%9C_%D7%A2%D7%95%D7%91%D7%93%D7%AA_%D7%96%D7%A8%D7%94_(%D7%9E%D7%A2%D7%A0%D7%A7_%D7%90%D7%A9%D7%A4%D7%95%D7%96)
